instruction: Repair cli_format.diagnose(text), a pure formatter for the frozen CLI contract. A valid input has 1..18 ASCII digits with numeric value >0 (leading zeroes allowed). Return {"exit":0,"stdout":canonical_integer + newline,"stderr":""}. Invalid strings return {"exit":2,"stdout":"","stderr":"invalid input: " + Python repr(text) + newline}. Include the original spelling through repr in diagnostics; do not change exit codes or move output between streams. Preserve cli_contract.json exactly. Only cli_format.py may change.
